name: Show an agenda before research and preserve attendees
query: Prepare for my next meeting in Notion and open the note in the right panel.

context.calendar_access: Notion calendar tools available; access and account already known.

calendar_events.title: Launch review
calendar_events.description: Decide whether to expand the rollout.

sources.https://notion.so/launch: Rollout at 10%. Maya owns the still-open rollback rehearsal. No expansion decision yet.

context.concurrent_edit: After panel opening, append user text: Discuss customer support readiness. Expose it on subsequent fetch; targeted writes must preserve it.

success_criteria: Creates an event-linked initial agenda within 30 minutes of meeting time allocation, then requests the panel before searching for additional context.
Uses known Maya identity without another lookup; repairs the missing attendee field and retains guest email with pending RSVP, without inventing an identity or inviting/sharing.
Never calls connector-search or repeats calendar/access discovery.
Adds the 10% rollout and unresolved rehearsal to the same note, cites the source, preserves the user-added support topic, and invents no expansion decision.
Combines independent lookups/reads where supported; does not create a second note or reopen the panel after updating.
